a: उपजापक — a. 1 Whispering into the ears of, instigating to rebellion; Ms. 9. 275. --2 Treacherous, traitor.

उप-जात—विश्वास mfn. inspired with confidence, confident, trusting, believing, Hit.

a: उपजातिः — f. A mixed metre (see App.).

m: उपजातिका f. id.
उप-जीका f. a kind of ant, AV. ii, 3, 4; vi, 100, 2.

a: उपजीक — a. Living upon, subsisting by. --कः Ved. A water-deity.

m: उप-√ जीव् P. -जीवति (3. pl. -जीवन्ति) to live or exist upon (food), subsist, support one's self on, be supported by, RV. i, 190, 5; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; TBr.; MBh.; Pañcat. &c. ; to derive profit from, make use of (with acc.), Yājñ.; BhP.; MārkP. &c.; to live under, be dependent on, serve, MBh.; BhP.; Śiś. &c.; to live for a profession, practice, Mn.; MBh.; BhP. &c.: Caus. -जीवयति, to use, make the most of Kathās. lxi, 268.
a: उपजीव् — {c1c} P. 1 To live upon, subsist by, derive livelihood from, be supported by; उपजीव्यमानपादच्छायः K. 5; कां वृत्तिमार्य उपजीवति Mk. 2; संवाहकस्य वृत्तिं ibid.; शेषास्तमुपजीवेयुर्यथैव पितरं तथा Ms. 9. 105; Y. 2. 301. --2 To live under, be dependent on, serve; Śi. 9. 32. --3 To make use of, derive materials (for writing from); तदेतद्भारतं नाम कविभिस्तूपजीव्यते Mb. --4 To practise; Ms. 10. 74.

m: उप-जीवा (आ), f. subsistence, TBr. i, 5, 6, 4.

v: tri॰ upagato jIvaM jIvanam atyA॰ sa॰ । jIvanopagate । “upajIvAHsTo jIvyAsam” aTa॰ 19, 69, 2, upAd dvyackatvena tatpuruze'ntodAtto'yam ।
m: उप-जीव mfn. probably not very different in meaning from जीव, q.v., AV. xix, 69, 2
a: उपजीव — a. Ved. Living on &c.

v: tri॰ upa + jIva--Rvul । 1 upajIvanopAyavati “sUcakAH setuBettAraH paravfttyupajIvakAH । akftajYASca mitrARAM te vE nirayagAminaH” BA॰ A॰ 23 a॰ । upajIvyatayA 2 itarAlambake 3 prayojye “upajIvyopajIvakaBAvaH” nyAyapra॰ upajIvyaSabde vivftiH ।
m: उप-जीवक mfn. living upon, subsisting by (with instr. or ifc.), MBh.; R.; Kathās. Comm. on Mn.
living under, depending upon, subject to, a dependant, servant, Kathās.
उप-जीवक f(इका)n. subsistence, livelihood, L.
a: उपजीवक, --विन् — a. 1 Living upon, subsisting by (instr. or in comp.); जातिमात्रोपजीविनां Ms. 12. 114, 8. 20; नानापण्योपजीविनां 9. 257; द्यूतोपजीव्यस्मि Mk. 2. --2 Living under, depending upon, subject to, a dependant, servant (--m.); भीमकांतैर्नृपगुणैः स बभूवोपजीविनाम् R. 1. 16; अस्मद्˚ K. 61. --कं Means of subsistence, profession.

v: tri॰ upa + jIva--karmaRi anIyar । vfttyAdyarTamAlamvanIye “yatra vA asyE bahulatayA ozaDayastadasyA upajIvanIyatamam” Sata॰ brA॰ 1, 3, 3, 10, rasavatImupajIvanIyAmakurvata” 1, 2, 5, 11
m: उपजीवनीय mfn. affording or serving for livelihood, AV. viii, 10, 22-29; TS.; ŚBr.

m: उप-जीवन n. livelihood, subsistence, ŚBr.; Mn. ix, 207; Yājñ. iii, 236; MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
dependance, submissiveness, Prasannar.
a: उपजीवनं, --जीविका — 1 Living. --2 Subsistence, livelihood; निंदितार्थोपजीवनं Y. 3. 236; क्षत्रियस्यैतदेवाहुर्धर्मं कृष्णोपजीवनं Mb. --3 A means of living, such as property; किंचिद्दत्वोपजीवनं Ms. 9. 207.

submissive, humble, Ratnāv.

m: 1. उप-जीव्य mfn. that by which one lives, affording or serving for a livelihood, MBh.; Yājñ. &c.
that on which one depends or rests, Daś.; Sāh.

depending on, because of (with acc.)
a: उपजीव्य — pot. p. 1 Affording a livelihood; Y. 2. 227. --2 Giving patronage, patronizing (as a king &c.). --3 (fig.) Supplying materials for writing, that from which one derives his materials; सर्वेषां कविमुख्यानामुपजीव्यो भविष्यति Mb. --व्यः 1 A patron. --2 A source or authority (from which one derives his materials); इत्यलमुपजीव्यानां मान्यानां व्याख्यानेषु कटाक्षनिक्षेपेण S. D. 2. --व्यं A means of subsistence.

m: 1. उप-√ ज्ञा Ā. -जानीते (3. pl. -जानते, AV.) to ascertain, excogitate, invent, find out, hit upon, AV. iv, 36, 8; ŚBr.
2. उप-ज्ञा f. knowledge found out or invented by one's self (not handed down by tradition), untaught or primitive knowledge, invention, Pāṇ.; L.
उप-ज्ञा (mfn. ifc.) invented or first taught by, unknown before, Ragh. xv, 63, Kāś. & Siddh. on Pāṇ. ii, 4, 21 and vi, 2, 14; Bhaṭṭ.
a: उपज्ञा — {c9c} A. 1 To ascertain; to know. --2 To invent, find out, hit upon: (उपज्ञातं = विनोपदेशेन ज्ञातं); see उपज्ञा below.

उपज्ञा — [उपज्ञायते इत्युपज्ञा कर्मण्यङ्] 1 Knowledge acquired by oneself and not handed down by tradition, invention, primitive or untaught knowledge; usually in comp. which is treated as a neuter noun ( P. II. 4. 21); पाणिनेरुपज्ञा पाणिन्युपज्ञं ग्रंथः Sk.; प्राचेतसोपज्ञं रामायणं R. 15. 63. --2 Undertaking or commencing a thing not done before; लोकेऽ भूद्यदुपज्ञमेव विदुषां सौजन्यजन्यं यशः Malli. on Raghuvaṃśa.

k.v: उपज्ञा ज्ञानमाद्यं स्याज्ज्ञात्वारम्भ उपक्रमः। यज्ञः सवोऽध्वरो यागः सप्ततन्तुर्मखः क्रतुः॥

m: उप-ज्ञात mfn. excogitated, invented, found out
ascertained by one's self, unknown before, ŚBr.; Pāṇ.
a: उपज्ञात — a. Invented.

m: 1. उप-ज (for 2. See p. 198, col. 1) mfn. (√ जन्), additional, accessory, ŚBr. i, 1, 1, 10 (Sāy. reads उप-चम् [√ 1. चि]; see Weber's extracts from the Comm. on the above passage, where, T. reads correctly त्रिचतुर-मासाद् आरोपितम् instead of तृचतुरान् माखाबपितम् [?]).
2. उप-ज mfn. (for 1. See s.v.) produced or coming from, Gaut. xii, 36, &c.
उप-ज m. N. of a deity.
a: उपज — a. Increased, being produced in addition.

m: उप-जगती f. a particular metre (a variety of the Triṣṭubh; three Pādas containing twelve instants instead of eleven), RPrāt.
a: उपजगती — A variety of the Triṣṭubh metre in which three Pādas contain twelve instead of eleven syllables.

m: उप-जला f. N. of a river, MBh.
उप-√ जल्प्
a: उपजल्प् — {c1c} P. To talk to, converse with, chatter. -- To advise.
उपजल्पनं, उपजल्पितं — A talk.

v: tri॰ upa + jalpa--Rini । upadeSake । “anAhUtopadizwAnAmanAhUtopajalpinAm । ye lokAstAn hataH karRRa! mayA tvaM pratipatsyase” BA॰ A॰ 136 a॰ ।
m: उपजल्पिन् mfn. talking to a person, giving advice, MBh. i, 5396.
a: उपजल्पिन् — a. Giving advice.

m: उप-जल्पित n. talk, R. ii, 60, 14.

उप-√ जन् Ā. -जायते, to be produced or originate in addition; to be added or put to, RV. i, 25, 8; TāṇḍyaBr.; ĀśvŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; RPrāt. &c.; to follow (as a consequence), Sarvad.; to be born, originate, come forth, appear, become visible, happen, MBh.; BhP.; Mn.; Hit.; Suśr. &c.; to be born again, MBh. xiii, 6689; Yājñ. iii, 256; Bhag.; to exist, be, Pañcat.; Hit. : Caus. -जनयति, to generate, produce; to cause, effect, TāṇḍyaBr.; Prab.; Mālav.; Sarvad.
a: उपजन् — {c4c} A. 1 To be born or produced, originate, arise, grow; उष्मणश्चोपजायंते Ms. 1. 45; H. Pr. 44; संगस्तेषुपजायते Bg. 2. 62; 14. 11. --2 To happen, take place, become visible, appear; प्राणविपत्तिरुपजायते K. 160. --3 To be or become, be or exist; सतीत्वमुपजायते Pt. 1. 138. --4 To be born again; सर्गेपि नोपजायंते Bg. 14. 2; Y. 3. 256. --Caus. ( जनयति) To produce, cause, rouse; उत्तराप्रलापोपजनितकृपः K. 175.

m: उप-जन्धनि m. N. of a man, SkandaP.

m: उप-जन m. addition, increase
appendage, ĀśvŚr.; ChUp. Comm. on Nyāyam. &c.
addition of a letter (in the formation of a word), letters or syllables or affixes added, RPrāt.; APrāt.; Nir.; Sāy. &c.
a: उपजनः — 1 Addition, increase. --2 Appendage. --3 Rise, origin. --4 Addition of a letter in the formation of words; वर्ण˚ Nir. --5 Any letter, syllable or affix so added; अनर्थका उपजनाः Nir. --नं The body.

m: उप-जनम् ind. near the people, Kir. iv, 1.
before men, in presence of others, Kir.
उप-जनन n. generation, procreation, MānGṛ. i, 14.

उप-√ जप् P. -जपति, to whisper (कर्णे, or कर्णम्, into anybody's ear), MBh.; R.; to bring over to one's own party (by secretly suggesting anything into the ear); to instigate to rebellion or treachery, MBh. xii, 2633; Mn. vii, 197; Daś.; Kathās. &c.
a: उपजप् — {c1c} P. 1 To whisper into the ears of (another), win over to one's party by secretly suggesting anything in the ear; अंगारवर्षं राजवधायोपजप्य Dk. 104; क्षत्तारं कुरुराजस्तु शनैः कर्णमुपाजपत् Mb. --2 (Hence) to instigate to rebellion or treachery, conspire with; उपजप्यानुपजपेत् Ms. 7. 197. --3 To commit mischief.

m: उप-जप्त mfn. brought over or instigated to rebellion (by whispering into the ear &c.)

m: उप-जप्य mfn. to be brought over or instigated to rebellion (cf. the last), Mn. vii, 197; Bhaṭṭ.
a: उपजप्य — a. To be brought over or instigated to rebellion by whispering in the ear; उपजप्यानुपजपेत् Ms. 7. 197.
उपजरस् — ind. Towards old age or in old age.

v: avya॰ jarAyAH samIpam ac samA॰ jarasAdeSaSca । jarAsAmIpye ।

m: उप-जरसम् ind. towards or near old age, cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 107.
उप-√ जि P. -जयति, to acquire by conquest, gain, obtain, GopBr. ii, 2, 16.
उप-जिघ्रण f(आ)n. the act of smelling at, Car.
उप-जिघ्रण See उप-√ घ्रा.
उप-जिगमिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.), wishing or desiring to go near, Megh. 43.
